rapport_notes: Professional and unbothered when the customer said he was still shopping around.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "What are your biggest concerns or what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?" — asked right after name/email, before logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer answered with scope ("looking for help with heavier items... considering taking care of boxes myself") and rep acknowledged ("we can definitely cater to moving big furniture") with no further "what else" follow-up.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: No explicit "just an estimate"/window or beats-it-pay-less line found in this call.

top_strength: Asked the agenda question early and delivered a fully personalized anchor estimate with all three Stage 2 differentiators.
coaching_note: Never covers the Communication differentiator (day-before call/named crew lead) or the Save Your Ass lines (window framing, beats-it-pay-less, self-prep tip, "does that feel fair") before the close ask.
